content_of_post_to_answer: What habit prevents people from becoming successful?
answer: A habit that quietly blocks success is constantly resetting the scoreboard. Many people abandon progress because they judge themselves only by big outcomes, ignoring the small systems that create them. The overlooked skill is staying committed while results are still invisible. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. Success often belongs to those who can keep building after the excitement has disappeared.
